coverage_interpretation: Depth-reference coverage includes source-selected inverse-transport sections and core context. It does not imply complete lower boundaries, full thickness fields, seasonal envelopes or volumes. Cruise/decade groups remain distinct. Local zero-flow boundaries from a processed climatology do not establish instantaneous or whole-route thickness. An upper-component depth reference does not cover the deep component; independent sections do not inherit unrelated width observations. Strict upper bounds are not point estimates. Overlapping mooring studies and model/observational cases remain distinct, without constructing numerical uncertainty or annual ranges. Deep domains with unspecified seafloor endpoints do not establish numerical thickness; spatially distinct summaries and current components remain separate. Source-reported regional thickness is distinct from bottom or core depth and is not a whole-route thickness field. Core operators and branch definitions remain explicit. Inclusive lower bounds preserve at-least statements. Thermohaline and velocity cores remain separately defined; named jets do not fill other families or basin identities. Regional variation within one campaign is not seasonal extrema. Winter-branch reach remains partial, and current-meander layer thickness is distinct from developed eddy extent. Seasonal model directions retain their separate sections and simulation time basis. Direction reversal is distinct from transport integration limits; regional mean core bands and observed section bands are not temporal extrema. Ranges of reach scales, depth bands across property cores and selected stream-tube domains remain distinct. Partial named branches and source reconstruction methods are explicit. Branch reach retains partial spatial scope. Instrument-limited reach and current-classification conventions are not detected physical bottoms. Mooring array means retain their own longitude and averaging months.
